title: Cosmic Neuron Terrarium
description: A glowing glass sphere sits on a black pedestal atop a white cloth with yellow and pink flowers. Inside the transparent orb, a bright pink neuron with multicolored branching dendrites connects to miniature cacti and desert flora, while a ringed planet floats in the upper right against a dark sky with orange rock formations in the background.
prompt: A large transparent glass sphere on a black pedestal contains a luminous pink neuron with yellow, green, blue and pink branching dendrites. Miniature saguaro and prickly pear cacti grow inside the orb alongside the neuron. A ringed planet floats in the upper right. The sphere rests on a white cloth with scattered yellow and pink poppies. In the background are towering orange desert rock formations under a deep purple night sky.
